'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Anthony Massung DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Massung]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
